_about: Template of model-card.json, the machine-readable card of a Brasa release. Do not fill it by hand: `brasa.evaluate`, `brasa.export` and `brasa.export_onnx` write every section when called with --model-card model-card.json (see README, 'Reproduce'). null marks a value that only exists after the real corpus has been trained on. scripts/render_model_card.py turns the filled file into the Hugging Face model card.

model._about: GPTConfig of the checkpoint plus the parameter count (written by brasa.evaluate from run.json).

training._about: Settings and measurements of the training run.

init_from._about: null for a run that started from random weights on the question corpus. Otherwise the brasa.pretrain run it started from (still from scratch: next-token prediction on public text from random weights) with the provenance of that text.

retrieval._about: null unless the run was trained with --retrieval-weight (the network also ranks the facts). weight: how much the cosine counts next to the normalised BM25 score, chosen on validation; recall: gold facts among the first k hits on held-out questions, for BM25 alone, the learned ranking alone and their fusion.

data._about: Statistics of the data directory. `corpus` is the optional corpus.json of the directory; a rehearsal corpus carries "fictional": true.

evaluation._about: One entry per weight format: float32 (the checkpoint, written by brasa.evaluate), float16 and int8 (the exported weights, written by brasa.export). Modes: open_book, closed_book (free decoding), open_book_constrained, closed_book_constrained (any curated sentence), open_book_retrieved (only the retrieved facts), open_book_ranked (the same with the retriever's ranking as a prior: the site's default) and first_hit (no model). `headline[mode][seen|val|test|final]` holds n, em, f1, in_scope_em, in_scope_f1, key_span_recall, refusal_precision, refusal_recall, language_consistency, unsupported_number_rate, verbatim_rate, right_topic_rate and, open-book only, retrieval_hit, gold_in_top1/2/4, em_when_gold_retrieved, em_when_gold_missed. `full[mode][split]` holds the same metrics as overall / by_lang / by_kind / by_topic / by_retrieval. `decoding` records how the open-book rows were produced: the retriever (bm25, bm25+own, bm25+encoder, with the fusion weight) and the ranking prior of open_book_ranked (kind, weight, fixed), chosen on validation by `brasa.evaluate --tune-prior`.

files._about: Size report of the export directory: bytes, gzip -9, brotli -11 and SHA-256 of every file.

quantisation._about: Weight and logit error of each exported format against the float32 checkpoint.
